capabilities: Toggle notes public or private from the file explorer, writing a public field into frontmatter
Push public notes and site source to a GitHub repository and enable Pages automatically
Auto-publish changed, added, or deleted notes a few seconds after edits
Track GitHub Actions build status and deploy progress with logs and diagnostics
Restyle the site with CSS presets and a custom CSS editor
extras: Stores connections, tokens, and repo working copies outside the vault in a system data directory; on Linux the GitHub token falls back to plain-text storage. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish a chosen subset of notes as a free static site while keeping private notes in the same vault.

relations.evidence: git clone / git push to upload your notes and the site source

requires.name: GitHub account with personal access token

summary: Publishes selected notes as a static blog on GitHub Pages, with per-note public toggles in the file explorer, one-click git push, and build tracking.
